mapper.sql: id, account, password_hash AS passwordHash, shop_name AS shopName, contact_mobile AS contactMobile, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, address, status, DATE_FORMAT(last_login_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastLoginAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt
id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName, role, CASE WHEN role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' THEN '系统管理员' ELSE role END AS roleLabel, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, status

m.id, m.store_id AS storeId, s.shop_name AS storeName, m.member_no AS memberNo, m.name, m.mobile, m.gender, m.age, m.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, m.status, AS availableBalance, AS totalBalance, AS rechargeBalance, AS giftBalance, AS accumulatedRecharge, AS accumulatedGift, AS accumulatedConsumption, w.recharge_count AS rechargeCount, w.consumption_count AS consumptionCount, DATE_FORMAT(m.joined_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS joinedAt
FROM store_member m JOIN store_account s ON s.id = m.store_id LEFT JOIN member_wallet w ON w.member_id = m.id

tx.id, tx.serial_no AS serialNo, tx.store_id AS storeId, s.shop_name AS storeName, tx.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, m.mobile, tx.original_transaction_id AS originalTransactionId, tx.type, tx.status, AS amount, AS giftAmount, AS beforeTotalBalance, AS afterTotalBalance, tx.payment_method AS paymentMethod, tx.serial_no AS orderNo, tx.item_name AS itemName, tx.remark, DATE_FORMAT(tx.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM store_account WHERE account = #{account} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM admin_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT sa.id, sa.account, sa.password_hash AS passwordHash, sa.shop_name AS shopName, sa.contact_mobile AS contactMobile, sa.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, sa.address, sa.status, DATE_FORMAT(sa.last_login_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastLoginAt, DATE_FORMAT(sa.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM login_session ls JOIN store_account sa ON sa.id = ls.principal_id WHERE ls.token = #{token} AND ls.principal_type = 'MERCHANT' AND ls.expires_at > #{now}

SELECT au.id, au.username, au.password_hash AS passwordHash, au.display_name AS displayName, au.role, CASE WHEN au.role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' THEN '系统管理员' ELSE au.role END AS roleLabel, au.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, au.status FROM login_session ls JOIN admin_user au ON au.id = ls.principal_id WHERE ls.token = #{token} AND ls.principal_type = 'ADMIN' AND ls.expires_at > #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_session (token, principal_type, principal_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{principalType}, #{principalId}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_account) AS storeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_account WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeStoreCount, AS totalRechargeAmount, AS pendingConsumptionAmount

SELECT sa.id, sa.account, sa.shop_name AS shopName, sa.contact_mobile AS contactMobile, sa.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, sa.address, sa.status, DATE_FORMAT(sa.last_login_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastLoginAt, DATE_FORMAT(sa.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, AS totalRechargeAmount, AS pendingConsumptionAmount FROM store_account sa ORDER BY sa.id

SELECT sa.id, sa.account, sa.shop_name AS shopName, sa.contact_mobile AS contactMobile, sa.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, sa.address, sa.status, DATE_FORMAT(sa.last_login_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastLoginAt, DATE_FORMAT(sa.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_member m WHERE m.store_id = sa.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status != 'DELETED') AS memberCount, AS totalRechargeAmount, AS pendingConsumptionAmount, AS totalGiftAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_member m WHERE m.store_id = sa.id AND m.created_at >= #{todayStart} AND m.created_at < #{tomorrowStart}) AS todayNewMembers, AS todayConsumptionAmount, AS todayRechargeAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_member m WHERE m.store_id = sa.id AND m.created_at >= #{weekStart} AND m.created_at < #{tomorrowStart}) AS weekNewMembers, AS weekConsumptionAmount, AS weekRechargeAmount FROM store_account sa WHERE sa.id = #{storeId}
SELECT tier_no AS tierNo, AS rechargeAmount, AS giftAmount, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM recharge_tier WHERE store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY tier_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_account (account, password_hash, shop_name, contact_mobile, avatar_url, address, status) VALUES (#{account}, #{passwordHash}, #{shopName}, #{contactMobile}, #{avatarUrl}, #{address}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE store_account SET shop_name = #{shopName}, contact_mobile = #{contactMobile}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, address = #{address}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recharge_tier (store_id, tier_no, recharge_amount, gift_amount) VALUES (#{storeId}, 1, 100.00, 10.00), (#{storeId}, 2, 200.00, 20.00), (#{storeId}, 3, 300.00, 35.00), (#{storeId}, 4, 500.00, 100.00)
INSERT INTO store_member (store_id, member_no, name, mobile, gender, age, avatar_url, status) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{memberNo}, #{name}, #{mobile}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{avatarUrl}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update:
UPDATE store_member
name = #{name}, mobile = #{mobile}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, status = #{status},
WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, recharge_balance AS rechargeBalance, gift_balance AS giftBalance, accumulated_recharge AS accumulatedRecharge, accumulated_gift AS accumulatedGift, accumulated_consumption AS accumulatedConsumption, recharge_count AS rechargeCount, consumption_count AS consumptionCount, version FROM member_wallet WHERE member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member_wallet SET recharge_balance = #{rechargeBalance}, gift_balance = #{giftBalance}, accumulated_recharge = #{accumulatedRecharge}, accumulated_gift = #{accumulatedGift}, accumulated_consumption = #{accumulatedConsumption}, recharge_count = #{rechargeCount}, consumption_count = #{consumptionCount}, version = version + 1 WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_transaction ( serial_no, store_id, member_id, original_transaction_id, idempotency_key, type, status, amount, gift_amount, before_recharge_balance, before_gift_balance, before_total_balance, after_recharge_balance, after_gift_balance, after_total_balance, payment_method, item_name, remark, operator_type, operator_id ) VALUES ( #{serialNo}, #{storeId}, #{memberId}, #{originalTransactionId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{type}, #{status}, #{amount}, #{giftAmount}, #{beforeRechargeBalance}, #{beforeGiftBalance}, #{beforeTotalBalance}, #{afterRechargeBalance}, #{afterGiftBalance}, #{afterTotalBalance}, #{paymentMethod}, #{itemName}, #{remark}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_transaction SET status = 'REVERSED', reversed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT shop_name AS storeName, address, 0 AS avgUsageMinutes, 0 AS openCount, CASE WHEN status = 'DISABLED' THEN 'LOW_ACTIVE' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS activityStatus, DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate FROM store_account ORDER BY id
